about.description: CHS is RedSwan Digital Real Estate's tokenized equity tranche in the Capri Hotel Southampton, a boutique hotel property in Southampton, NY, issued on Hedera and Stellar for accredited investors.
about.registryInfo: Issuing entity Marquis Hamptons, LLC (no SEC EDGAR filings found - pre-offering). Issued in parallel on Hedera (two deployments) and Stellar Soroban (two deployments), each carrying identical full supply - only the primary Hedera token is tracked to avoid quadruple counting. Zero transfer events since creation; listings are in "Express Interest" status on RedSwan's marketplace ("not for sale"), with no SEC filings yet for the issuing LLCs - pre-offering stage with 100% issuer-held supply.
